[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Lon Isoto]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] lived in a lavish '''palace''' in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Vuultin]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]]. There, he was attended by [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and concubines.
